release_scope.endpoint_boundary: The current core supports exact adjusted-close quotes on required official sessions only. Any unresolved endpoint makes the cell non-estimable and the study INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; suspension-valuation and delisting-terminal-wealth adapters are not authorized.
release_scope.claim_boundary: The strongest authorized accounting-timing claim is a recorded-publication-date specification effect in a single-version provider snapshot. Revision, vintage-value, historical-investor-observed-value, announcement-reaction, and return-timing claims remain unauthorized.

signature.trust_boundary: Identity and evidence authenticity require independent human verification.

authorization_semantics: This artifact records an externally reviewed authorized scope and chronology. It is immutable once hashed and is not itself a cryptographic nonce or revocation service. Before any outcome load, the local runner must atomically create the exclusive consumption sidecar specified below; a second claim for the same authorization and protected sidecar directory fails closed. This local marker does not prove external identity, prevent a custodian from deleting storage, or replace human registration and authorization.

consumption_contract.atomic_creation: exclusive create (O_CREAT|O_EXCL, mode 0600) before loading quotes, fundamentals, or computing outcomes
consumption_contract.single_use_scope: one authorization hash per protected sidecar directory
consumption_contract.failure_rule: A failed or interrupted claim remains consumed and requires a new authorization.
consumption_contract.release_boundary: No outcome-data load or factor/outcome computation may occur before the sidecar is durably created.
consumption_contract.operational_boundary: The custodian must protect the sidecar directory from deletion, replacement, and concurrent writers; this implementation cannot prove that boundary against a privileged operator.

final_envelope_rule: Only after this authorization is completed and hashed may its SHA-256 and authorized_at be copied into the final execution-plan envelope as execution_authorization_sha256 and locked_at. This authorization binds the frozen plan core, not the later envelope, so no hash cycle is created.
completion_gate: Every assertion must be true, every required hash and timestamp must be populated and independently verified, status must become authorized, outcome_data_release_permitted_after_authorized_at must become true, and outcome-data release must still not have occurred when this authorization is signed.
